TransactionContract: READ COMMITTED, read-write; provider transaction completion awaited

AllocationAttribution: whole-process end-to-end total; business DTO/string/JSON and harness async state included; framework-only attribution unproven
EmptyDriverScope: same workers/gate/validation/metrics; returns precomputed result; does not model asynchronous I/O continuations
